title: [Main]- Incorrect calculation of single-level capacity and material cost for Stockkeeping Units (SKU) when running cost changes in the Standard Cost Worksheet and implementing the Standard Cost change
summary: Fixed incorrect calculation of single-level capacity and material costs for stockkeeping units during standard cost changes by skipping unconditional SKU cost updates when the Load SKU Cost on Manufacturing setting is disabled.
key_points: The Implement Standard Cost Change report was incorrectly copying item cost shares to SKUs regardless of the Load SKU Cost on Manufacturing setting
Report now skips SKU cost updates in this scenario
Users are directed to recalculate SKU costs using the Calc. Standard Cost action on the Stockkeeping Unit Card
Fixes discrepancies in cost calculations for SKU-specific costing
quote: Skip SKU cost updates in this mode and instruct users to recalculate SKU costs using Calc. Standard Cost on the Stockkeeping Unit Card.
